description_en: Queries the details of a specified VPC peering connection
description_zh: 调用GetVpcPeerConnectionAttribute接口查询指定VPC对等连接的详细信息
name: GetVpcPeerConnectionAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC peering connection
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询详细信息的VPC对等连接实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

AcceptingOwnerUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the acceptor of the VPC peering connection
AcceptingOwnerUid.description_zh: VPC对等连接接收端的阿里云账号ID

AcceptingRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the acceptor of the VPC peering connection
AcceptingRegionId.description_zh: VPC对等连接接收端的地域ID

AcceptingVpc.description_en: The details of the acceptor VPC-connected instance

Ipv4Cidrs.description_en: The IPv4 CIDR blocks of the acceptor

items.description_en: The IPv4 CIDR blocks of the acceptor

Ipv6Cidrs.description_en: The IPv6 CIDR blocks of the acceptor

items.description_en: The IPv6 CIDR blocks of the acceptor

VpcId.description_en: The instance ID of the acceptor VPC-connected instance

Bandwidth.description_en:
The bandwidth of the VPC peering connection. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: integers greater than 0.

A value of -1 indicates that the bandwidth is not limited.

Default values:
The default bandwidth of a cross-region VPC peering connection is 1024 Mbit/s.
The default bandwidth of an intra-region VPC peering connection is -1 Mbit/s, which indicates that the bandwidth is not limited
Bandwidth.description_zh:
VPC对等连接的带宽，单位：Mbps，取值范围为大于0的整数。

例外取值-1，表示无带宽限制。

默认值如下：
跨地域VPC对等连接的带宽默认值为1024 Mbps。
同地域VPC对等连接的带宽默认值为-1 Mbps，即不限制带宽

BizStatus.description_en:
The billing status of the VPC peering connection. Valid values:

Normal: Normal.
FinancialLocked: Locked due to overdue payments
BizStatus.description_zh:
VPC对等连接的商业状态。取值：

Normal：正常。
FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

Description.description_en: The description of the VPC peering connection

EnableJumboFrame.description_en:
Indicates whether the jumbo frame feature is enabled for the VPC peering connection. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
EnableJumboFrame.description_zh:
VPC 对等连接是否开启了 Jumbo frame 特性。取值：
true：开启。
false：未开启

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the VPC peering connection was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
GmtCreate.description_zh: VPC对等连接的创建时间。使用UTC时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

GmtExpired.description_en:
The expiration time of the VPC peering connection.

A specific expiration time is returned only when the Status of the VPC peering connection is Accepting or Expired. If the VPC peering connection is in other states, null is returned
GmtExpired.description_zh:
VPC对等连接的过期时间。

只有当VPC对等连接的Status（状态）为Accepting（接收中）或Expired（已过期）时，才会返回具体的过期时间；VPC对等连接处于其余状态时，返回值为null

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the VPC peering connection was modified. The time is displayed in UTC in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
GmtModified.description_zh: VPC对等连接的修改时间。使用UTC时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC peering connection

LinkType.description_en:
The link type of the VPC peering connection.

Default values:
The default link type of a cross-region VPC peering connection is Gold.
The default link type of an intra-region VPC peering connection is empty
LinkType.description_zh:
VPC对等连接的链路类型。

默认值如下：
跨地域VPC对等连接的默认链路类型为Gold（金）。
同地域VPC对等连接的默认链路类型为空

Name.description_en: The name of the VPC peering connection

OwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the requester of the VPC peering connection
OwnerId.description_zh: VPC对等连接发起端的阿里云账号ID

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the requester of the VPC peering connection
RegionId.description_zh: VPC对等连接发起端的地域ID

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

Status.description_en:
The status of the VPC peering connection. Valid values:

Creating: Creating.
Accepting: Accepting.
Updating: Updating.
Rejected: Rejected.
Expired: Expired.
Activated: Activated.
Deleting: Deleting.
Deleted: Deleted. 

For more information about the statuses of VPC peering connections, see [VPC peering connection overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/418507.html）
Status.description_zh:
VPC对等连接的状态。取值：

Creating：创建中。
Accepting：接收中。
Updating：更新中。
Rejected：已拒绝。
Expired：已过期。
Activated：已激活。
Deleting：删除中。
Deleted：已删除。 


关于VPC对等连接状态的更多信息，请参见[VPC对等连接概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/418507.html）

Vpc.description_en: The details of the requester VPC-connected instance
